The migration is complete and fully verified. Final state: fresh server, latest build, **8/8 scenarios, 45/45 steps passing**.

## What was built

The Angular 18 app under `src/app/` (standalone components, strict TS), mirroring the GWT screens one-for-one:

| GWT source | Angular |
|---|---|
| `ApplicationView` (shell) | `app.component.*` — header, messages area, main slot, plus the `gwt-debug-dom` marker the tests wait for |
| `HeaderView` | `widgets/header/` — menubar `gwt-debug-menubar` with links to all five GWT history tokens, active-item class, logout (`gwt-debug-logout` → `DELETE /api/session`) |
| `MessagesPresenter`/`MessageWidget` | `widgets/messages/` + `core/messages.service.ts` — `gwt-debug-successMessage`/`gwt-debug-errorMessage` boxes, text in the first `<span>`, dismissible `X`, 5 s auto-close (`MessageCloseDelay.DEFAULT`) |
| `ManufacturerView`/`EditManufacturerView` | `manufacturer/` — table `gwt-debug-manufacturers` (ID/Name/Edit/Delete, Edit+Delete as last two columns, rows in the first `<tbody>`), create button, popup with `manufacturer-editor/input/save/close` ids; append-on-create, replace-in-place-on-edit, `window.confirm("Are you sure you want to delete X?")` |
| `RatingView`/`EditRatingView` | `rating/` — table `gwt-debug-ratings` (ID/Car/Rating/Delete), Car cell renders `Manufacturer/Model` (`RatingDto.toString()`), create form loads cars first (`ratingInput`/`ratingSave`), confirm before delete |
| `ReportView` | `report/` — table `gwt-debug-reports` (Manufacturer/Rating) |
| `NameTokens`/`DebugIds`/DTOs/JAX-RS resources | `name-tokens.ts`, `debug-ids.ts`, `core/dto.ts`, `core/api-paths.ts`, `core/api.service.ts` (only real endpoints: `/api/manufacturers[/ratings|/{id}]`, `/api/ratings`, `/api/cars?offset=0&limit=-1`, `/api/session`) |

**Routing**: `provideRouter(routes, withHashLocation())` with route paths = GWT history tokens, plus a custom `GwtUrlSerializer` that drops the leading `/`, so URLs and link hrefs are exactly GWT-shaped (`#manufacturer`, `#rating`, `#report`) — which the e2e's `waitUntilPlaceIsLoaded` (`url.contains("#token")`) requires.

## How it was verified

I rebuilt the original Cucumber harness in `/tmp/e2e-verify` (cucumber 1.2.5 + Selenium 3.141.59 + gwt-user 2.7.0 — matching the prepared `~/.m2` artifacts) using the **unmodified** `e2e/` page objects, step definitions and features, plus the upstream base classes adapted only for the out-of-scope login. Against `sh backend/run.sh` (fresh, re-seeded datastore):

- Full suite: **8/8 scenarios, 45/45 steps** (Manufacturers 5, Ratings 2, Reports 1) — reproduced on multiple fresh runs
- Pinned order Manufacturers → Ratings → Reports: all pass
- Re-run on an already-mutated datastore — including the corrupted state where a deleted manufacturer orphans cars and the backend's own reports endpoint NPEs (the original GWT app breaks here too): all pass, via a `null/<model>` Car-cell fallback

One subtle Angular finding along the way: `{provide: UrlSerializer, useClass: MySerializer}` silently instantiates `DefaultUrlSerializer` when the subclass inherits the abstract class's `ɵprov` factory — fixed by decorating the serializer with `@Injectable()`.
